question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Peril
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Peril"** means serious and immediate danger. (खतरा)

 
 
• **Example: **The hikers were in great** peril **when they got lost in the mountains.
 
 
 
• **"Danger"** refers to the possibility of suffering harm or injury. (जोखिम)
 
 
• **Example: **He was in **dange**r of losing his job due to repeated mistakes.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of** 'Peril' is 'Danger'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entertainment** (मनोरंजन): The action of providing or being provided with amusement or enjoyment.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was pure** entertainment** from start to finish.
 
 
 
• **Joke** (मज़ाक): A thing that someone says to cause amusement or laughter.
 
 
• **Example: **He told a **joke** that had everyone laughing.
 
 
 
• **Ignorance** (अज्ञानता): Lack of knowledge or information.
 
 
• **Example:** His **ignorance** about the subject was evident in the debate.
